description: This file defines a FaissIndex wrapper class for managing a FAISS vector index with disk persistence, including methods for loading, saving, adding text chunks, and searching the index.

classes.name: FaissIndex
classes.description: Wrapper around a FAISS index with disk persistence, supporting adding document chunks and searching.

methods.name: __init__(self, index_path: str | None = None, dim: int = 384)
methods.description: Initializes the FaissIndex, loading or creating the index as needed.

methods.name: _load(self)
methods.description: Loads the FAISS index and associated IDs from disk if they exist; otherwise creates a new index.

methods.name: _persist(self)
methods.description: Saves the current index and IDs to disk.

methods.name: add_text_chunks(self, document_id: int, chunks: List[str], vector_dim: int | None = None)
methods.description: Adds text chunks for a document to the FAISS index with generated vectors.

methods.name: List[Tuple[float,Tuple[int,int]]] search(self, query: str, top_k: int = 5)
methods.description: Performs a search query against the FAISS index returning top-k closest matches.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, index_path: str | None = None, dim: int = 384):$/
ctags.signature: (self, index_path: str | None = None, dim: int = 384)

ctags.name: add_text_chunks
ctags.pattern: /^    def add_text_chunks(self, document_id: int, chunks: List[str], vector_dim: int | None = None/
ctags.signature: (self, document_id: int, chunks: List[str], vector_dim: int | None = None)

ctags.name: search
ctags.pattern: /^    def search(self, query: str, top_k: int = 5) -> List[Tuple[float, Tuple[int, int]]]:$/
